payload.headline: Fresh-subsystem sweep: 10 agent-owned defects + 4 founder-approved matcher corrections; suite 207/207 -> 212/212
patterns: A read-only gate must distinguish 'cannot reach' from 'wrong target'. ATLAS's trust-graph parity probe reported wrong-project 404s as a transport blip and produced no verdict for 16 days while showing a benign yellow. Any project consuming a GENERIC single-project capability (supabase.client/supabase.admin) should assert the resolved project identity before trusting a result.
A permanently-advisory check is indistinguishable from a check nobody has. Escalate on the ABSENCE of a verdict across N runs, independent of what is measured.

A doctor needs three tiers, not two: pass / warn / blocking leaves a real red that the project does not own with nowhere honest to go — it either wedges every closeout or gets downgraded into a warning and stops looking like a failure. Add a failing-but-not-blocking tier.

Prove the red in the same commit as the guard. Two guards written this session were green against the very defect they targeted: one matched an adjacent GET handler because the route contract needle was only a path, one read a partially-written state because the generator writes in two passes.
When N copies of a routine exist, a fix applied to N-1 of them looks complete. S94 repaired 2 of 3 override-refresh copies; S101 B16/B18 repaired 1 of 2 surfaces twice.
escalated: scoring E5: a second hand-typed confidence derivation publishing 0.484 where the freshness-gated scorer says 0/blocked
scoring E6: isScorableEvidence allow-lists a status the corpus never emits and drops real weakly_supported rows

payload.headline: A capability that cannot be RESOLVED is not one whose credentials are MISSING — and the studio DR backup had been failing on that distinction, unescalated, for nine consecutive nights.
bullets: The Postgres-to-R2 backup held 19 receipts and 2 successes, both ad-hoc local. CI seeded all five credentials and never CAPABILITY_MAP.json, the gitignored schema that names which variables a capability needs. Committed a names-only export (72 capabilities, no values) and a per-run seed, guarded on export and on seed.

Escalation moved from age to a lane-aware failure streak: one manual success had been resetting a 12h clock that nine failed nights never moved. Receipts now carry a lane read from the runner, and an unlabelled success cannot clear a lane-filtered streak. True reading: 14 consecutive scheduled-lane failures, no proven success.

The startup brief had printed audit premises UNVERIFIED for thirty sessions because S311 remedy could never fire in its only caller — the brief runs before the doctor it depends on. Fixed order-independently; proven with the cache deleted.
Applies fleet-wide: if your CI resolves a capability, check the workflow seeds the capability map. A workflow that resolves a capability it never seeds fails preflight with every credential present.

payload.headline: A gate that cannot fail on its own finding
payload.summary: Three gates in the enforcing chain printed a non-measuring state and exited 0. Flagship cause: two capability vocabularies with an EMPTY intersection left the scope-creep monitor measuring nothing since W140, and a --strict added in S285 to restore teeth could never fire from the state the gate was actually in. Closed the class with check-gate-verdict-teeth: runs every chain gate, population derived from package.json, fails on NON-MEASURING-BUT-GREEN or LEAKED-ERROR-BUT-GREEN. Behavioural by necessity - a static scan for the shape returns 0 of 54.
